```flowproof
workflow analyze_topic
  needs topic: text
  role analyst can answer
  budget at most 4 calls

  let count = ask analyst: """
    How many independent sub-questions does this topic have? Reply with one number.
    Topic: {topic}
    """ as number

  fork 3 into answers
    let answer = ask analyst: """
      Topic: {topic}
      It has {count} independent sub-questions. Answer the topic as a whole.
      """
    keep answer
  end

  give answers
end
```
